name: Drupal Remote Dashboard
description: Dashboard to monitor and manage any number of remote Drupal 6, 7 or 8 sites
project_description:
Drupal agencies, freelancers, site builders and even Drupal site owners do need DRD (Drupal Remote Dashboard) because it is the one and only solution that provides a non-intrusive insight into any number of remote Drupal sites without the need of any third party service.

 No matter where the Drupal sites are hosted and regardless of any configuration or deployment specifics, DRD is able to monitor and manage them all at once. The dashboard is build for Drupal 8 and Drupal 9, the monitored remote sites are supported on Drupal 6, 7, 8 and 9.

 
 The 4.1.x branch is supported on Drupal 10 and Drupal 11 
 The 4.0.x branch is supported on Drupal 8.8+ and Drupal 9 
 The 3.x branch is supported on Drupal 8 
 The 2.x branch is supported on Drupal 7

 Dependencies 
 On remote sites you have to install the DRD Agent module first.

 Other dependencies:

 
 Entity views attachment 
 Key value field
